reviews.text: Very  pleased with service.

I have used Skool of Drool for over 10 years with my dogs. My older dog loved daycare when he was with us & When I brought my rescue to the family 5 years ago they really helped settle him & worked with him to get used to playing with other dogs. I completely trust them & would recommend
Lottie loves Skool of drool ! Been going since she was a pup  Every dog treated like their own, highly recommend

My dog has been at Skool of Drool since she was a puppy and there’s no other people I’d rather look after her. The staff are so knowledgeable and every single one of them genuinely care about the dogs they look after. They know my dog well and have taken time to truly understand what makes her tick.

On the staff, they do everything they can, they are always flexible, supportive and responsive. Viviana has built a really strong team and you can see her influence across the whole set up.

As well as daycare, I have also taken part in one-on-one coaching which really helped me improve my communication with dog and was time and money well spent.

Would recommend this company.
Bandit loves his visits with Skool of Drool he gets so excited when the van comes. Cannot recommend highly enough, all the staff are so caring and friendly. Thank you 🙏 🩵💚❤️💛 …

The team are a godsend. They helped us care for our dog Sheldon for 10 years loving him like their own and now it's his brother Truman's turn. Truman just adores his days with his aunties and his pals. Best in the business.

We honestly couldn’t imagine Alfie going anywhere else. ❤️

From the moment he gets picked up in the morning, we know he’s in the safest, most loving hands with his Aunties and all of his wonderful friends. As dog parents, there’s nothing more important than having complete trust in the people caring for your dog, and the team at Skool of Drool gives us that peace of mind every single day.

The professionalism, knowledge and genuine love they have for every dog shines through in everything they do. Alfie absolutely adores his daycare days and comes home happy, fulfilled and content after spending the day doing what dogs should be doing, running, exploring, playing and socialising in a beautiful natural environment!

What makes Skool of Drool so special is that it isn’t just another daycare. The dogs have the freedom, space and enrichment they need to truly be themselves, all whilst being carefully supervised and cared for by a team who treats them as if they were their own.

When work commitments mean we can’t be with Alfie everyday, there’s nowhere else we’d rather leave him. Knowing he’s spending his day having adventures in his daycare fields, making memories with his pals and receiving so much love and care makes all the difference ❤️

Thank you to all of Alfie’s Aunties for everything you do. We are incredibly grateful and couldn’t recommend Skool of Drool more highly. 🐾❤️
Best in the business

Bella has been attending Skool of Drool for the past two years and we couldn’t be happier with the service. The collection and drop-off from home make life so much easier.

Most importantly, Bella absolutely loves her daycare days. She gets the opportunity to be off lead in a secure environment, socialising and playing with other dogs, something she doesn’t get the chance to do elsewhere. She comes home happy and tired having had a wonderful time.

What really stands out is the genuine care and affection the team has for the dogs. It’s clear this is much more than just a business to them. They know the dogs as individuals, understand their personalities and treat them like their own. I have complete confidence that Bella is safe, well cared for and having the best day whenever she’s with them. Highly recommended!
Viviana, i don't care about the rain. You can leave my dogs home CAKED from head to toe in mud every time and i will gladly take care of it!  😁 Much love always from moi, Moonbeam and Daisy. …

A neighbour recommended using Skool of Drool for our young Golden Retriever , Danny several months ago. They have been fantastic. We needed help getting him socialised with other dogs and to give him more opportunities to run off lead and have fun. He can’t wait to get into the van at pick up in the morning for a fun filled day. I’m convinced he would actually go into the van by himself. The girls have all been great with him. I would highly recommend Skool of Drool to anyone. Photo of Danny all chilled after a Skool Day!

Our working Cocker Spaniel Rùm has been attending day care at Skool of Drool for over 4 years now. The whole Skool of Drool team are amazing & we can go to work each day safely knowing that Rum will be well looked after, well exercised and mentally stimulated out in the field. Rum is picked up and dropped off each day and is always raring to go each morning to get with her 'Aunties'
We have been working with Viviana through communication sessions to help with anxities Rùm has had with roads - these have been brillianrt 🐾🤎

Absolutely brilliant bunch of girls don’t know how to thank them for looking after my gorgeous dog would recommend them cos ano my dog is safe and absolutely loves going and playing with other dogs brilliant

My bulldog Izzy has been attending Skool of Drool for several months and absolutely loves it. The team genuinely care about the dogs as individuals and take the time to understand their personalities, needs and quirks.

Izzy is always excited when it’s a Skool day and is usually waiting by the door for her Aunties to arrive. The secure outdoor environment is perfect for her, giving her the opportunity to socialise, play, sniff and explore with other dogs in a safe, supervised setting.

As the owner of a rescue dog with some separation anxiety and a few bulldog-specific quirks, it’s reassuring to know she is with people who understand dogs and put their welfare first. The communication is excellent, and it is obvious how much love and care goes into everything they do.

I would highly recommend Skool of Drool to anyone looking for a safe, professional and caring daycare for their dog.
Sonny absolutely loves his time at doggy day care . I know he is in safe hands and it’s his favourite time of the week when he goes

Fantastic team always going above and beyond for my girls. They love going to skool and actually cry at the window waiting to be collected. I feel its dramatically improved there life. Running around in the fields with there friends while im at work, i know they are in good hands. Thanks so much.
Fabulous fun and diligent care for my precious boy. Professional and caring service.

My dog absolutely loves the days out a chance to run free and play
Great service collected and dropped off by their friendly staff

Best doggy day care ever!! Been using for 7 years and wouldn’t go anywhere else. Dogs are in safe hands and all the team are fantastic. You can clearly see this is a team that cares about all the dogs. I feel my girls are 100% safe and looked after xx
Love everything about Skool of Drool but our doggies love it one million times more!

Max is only 2 but has been attending Skool of Drool for a year and I’m 100% sure he loves it. 🐾 He gets to run wild, chase balls, socialise and all the videos show him doing this and more. I’m happy that he’s happy, safe & well cared for on the days I have to be in the office. Couldn’t ask for more so highly recommend 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 …

The Skoolofdrool is a brilliant way of making your dog happy and enjoying there time with other dogs. Our two dogs have really blossomed since we started sending them every Monday. They absolutely adore the way they are loved and cared for. Viviana and her team are so much involved with their community of dogs.

This is truly the best place for my dog. As soon as I put his harness on, he knows what happening and sits at the window with his tail wagging. As soon as he sees the van, he goes nuts😁. He loves the team, being with other dogs, and the freedom to play and roam in a wide, but safe environment. I see the videos, and the girls give the dogs so much attention, they love it. Viviana Victoria has been with Jude since he was a pup, she and now the wider team, give him so much joy.

My Dog has been going to school of drool for a few years now. It started on a part time basis to socialise him, but now having low mobility he attends full time. I cannot  praise the team enough. I know my boy’s happy as he bounds out of the door tail wagging and he has special bond with his “ aunties” . I would not hesitate in recommending Skool of Drool if you are looking for doggy day care
